mapper.select: SELECT a.appoint_id AS appointId, e.examination_id AS examinationId, c.child_name AS childName, ei.expert_name AS doctorName, e.start_time AS startTime, e.end_time AS endDate, CASE WHEN NOW() < e.start_time THEN 1 WHEN NOW() >= e.start_time AND NOW() <= e.end_time THEN 2 WHEN NOW() > e.end_time AND NOW() <= DATE_ADD(e.end_time, INTERVAL 7 DAY) THEN 3 ELSE NULL END AS status FROM personal_examination_record e LEFT JOIN expert_info ei ON e.doctor_id = ei.expert_id INNER JOIN examination_appoint a ON e.examination_id = a.examination_id LEFT JOIN child_info c ON a.child_id = c.child_id WHERE e.doctor_id = #{expertId} ORDER BY e.start_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO physical_exam ( report_id, appoint_id, child_id, height, weight, head_circ, vision, hearing, tooth, heart, abdomen, limb, skin, nerve, suggestion, exam_date, doctor ) VALUES ( #{reportId}, #{appointId}, #{childId}, #{height}, #{weight}, #{headCirc}, #{vision}, #{hearing}, #{tooth}, #{heart}, #{abdomen}, #{limb}, #{skin}, #{nerve}, #{suggestion}, #{examDate}, #{doctor} )
